pages.title: Tachyon Singularity
pages.text: Tachyon crystals crushed into a single point that seems to arrive before it is placed. Tachyons move faster than light, and this point moves faster still. It is cold, faintly blue, and seems to be leaving.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Tachyons can never slow below light speed. Crushing tachyon crystals in the Singularity Compactor gave me a point that seems to be everywhere it will be, slightly early.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
